title: Chanel unveils Swiss chalet-themed gifting suite at Harrods for festive season
summary: The Chanel Holiday Season Animation shop-in-shop activation at London’s luxury department store Harrods is described as a ‘magical alpine escape’, offering exclusive festive gift sets and Holiday 2026 Collection items in a snowy gifting suite
